decisions.reason: The two-component glass flake spraying system extends the firm's core spraying expertise into heavy-duty corrosion protection, so the engineering already invested and its fit with the firm's direction favour keeping it, and weak early results can still be put down to the market ramp-up.
The low-pressure injection pump sits close to the established construction repair offer and has its own web page, a visible public commitment that management will want to justify by keeping it.

A product line of several models represents substantial sunk development and tooling investment and is central to material conveying, so management will persist with it and treat any disappointment as temporary.

Fire protection flow monitoring has its own web page and supports the announced push toward digitalized, monitored production, so management stays committed even though it is further from the core equipment offer.
